operations.research_note: Visually verified original printed page185 of1921 Amnesty and Pardon hearing (Internet Archive scan n190). Row spells name Troy Deason, Texas western district, March8,1918 sentence eighteen months at Leavenworth. Appeal affirmed; Supreme Court certiorari denied March24,1919; committed April22,1919; sentence commuted May24,1919 to one year and one day. Added missing sentencing date only. Existing Desson spelling and sentence-not-stated prose flagged for separate correction; did not treat commutation as actual release or equate sentencing with custody admission.
